hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my breaths steady and my eyes fixed on the soft glow of the candle. Suddenly, I felt a pair of eyes on me, and my heart raced. I turned to see a woman, her hair a cascade of golden waves, sitting by the open book. Her gaze was fixed on me, and I felt the heat of her desire in every pulse. I couldn't help but smile, wondering if she noticed my blush. This room, dimly lit by the candle, was our secret hideaway, and I found myself wanting to know more.
caption:
A new face in my quiet corner...
